newsitem.title: BERMUDA: New political risk insurer formed in Bermuda.
newsitem.headline: New political risk insurer formed in Bermuda.

text.p: Bermuda-based ACE Ltd and EXEL Ltd said they and U.S.-based Risk Capital Holdings Inc have agreed to form a managing general agency in Bermuda to provide political risk coverage.
The new company, Sovereign Risk Insurance Ltd, will issue subscription policies with ACE, EXEL and Risk Capital underwriting 45 percent, 45 percent and 10 percent respectively, they said.
Sovereign will initially offer limits of up to $50 million per project and $100 million per country, they said.
Sovereign's per country limits are expected to increase to $500 million by the fifth year of operations, ACE and EXEL said.
Sovereign anticipates receiving submissions from a global client base through Bermuda-based intermediaries.
Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc's Marsh & McLennan Risk Capital Corp acted as an advisor to the transaction.
Price Lowenstein, 37, formerly with Guy Carpenter & Co Inc in San Francisco, will become president and chief executive officer of Sovereign Risk.
Lowenstein has nine years experience in the political risk insurance business, the companies said.

ACE and EXEL said the formation of Sovereign Risk comes in response to increasing levels of foreign direct investment including projects in developing countries and rising demand for political risk insurance.
"We feel the timing is excellent for a new entity to enter the private sector political risk insurance market, ACE chief executive Brian Duperreault said.
"Through a flexible, client-driven approach to this business, we are confident that Sovereign will quickly become a major player in this market," he said.

ACE, EXEL and Risk Capital will provide "significant new capacity in this dynamic area, not only to our core customers, but also to other international investors," EXEL chief executive Brian O'Hara said.
